title: Emergency Communications Plan
description: Sets out a layered family plan for jammed networks, cell outages, and total failure: an out-of-town contact, text-first check-ins, ICE contacts, and a family password. Covers current FCC rules for FRS, GMRS, ham, and CB radio (including why privacy codes aren't private), visual and sound signals, location plans, equipment, and drills.
shortDescription: Text-first plan, out-of-town contact, FRS/GMRS/ham/CB rules, and signals
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
